skill.name: ai-image-generation
skill.description: Generate hosted images through Luxin without provider credentials or a local model server. The workflow supports guided setup, spending limits, durable URLs, recoverable jobs, and cost receipts.
skill.summary: Create durable hosted AI images through a guided Luxin workflow.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: The documented workflow executes remote npm packages and performs unattended global skill installs. It also directs agents to execute a server-provided next command without validating its contents.

remediation.issue: The guide runs luxin-cli through the mutable latest tag.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited package version and integrity value, then document a review process for version updates.

remediation.issue: Agents may execute data.next_command supplied by the hosted guide.
remediation.suggestion: Parse the response as structured arguments and allow only documented Luxin subcommands after explicit user approval.

remediation.issue: Installation examples use global scope and automatic confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Default to a scoped installation, remove automatic confirmation, and explain every directory the installer will modify.

remediation.issue: The fallback changes HOME and CODEX_HOME to hidden workspace directories.
remediation.suggestion: Warn that credentials and profile state may enter the workspace, and require an ignored directory with restrictive permissions.

remediation.issue: The feedback workflow uploads attempted commands and observed behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval and redact prompts, credentials, paths, and private task details before feedback submission.

content.user_title: Generate Hosted AI Images with Luxin
content.value_statement: Image generation often requires provider credentials, local infrastructure, and separate billing. This skill guides agents through Luxin with spending controls and durable hosted results.
actual_capabilities: Starts with a guided command that can verify readiness without media spending.
Creates hosted images from text prompts through the Luxin CLI.
Selects a model, creation intent, and maximum estimated cost per image.
Provides durable media URLs, recoverable jobs, cost receipts, and stable structured responses.
Documents installation commands for Codex and other compatible agents.
limitations: The workflow depends on the Luxin hosted service and network availability.
Image creation may require approved spending after the no-spend guide.
The examples execute remote npm packages and should use an audited pinned version.
Model availability, latency, policy support, and payment options depend on Luxin.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Illustrations
use_cases.description: Generate durable concept images and illustrations while recording estimated cost and model settings.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Mockups
use_cases.description: Create hosted product visuals that applications can reference through persistent media URLs.

use_cases.title: Automate Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Run guided image jobs with spending limits, recoverable state, and consistent structured results.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of [subject] in [style]. Use the no-spend guide first and ask before any paid creation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one image with clear cost approval.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a product image of [product] on [setting] with [lighting]. Keep the estimated cost below [budget] per image.
prompt_templates.scenario: A product team needs a controlled visual mockup.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Concept Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate [count] distinct concepts for [brief]. Preserve each job, model setting, hosted URL, and cost receipt for comparison.
prompt_templates.scenario: A creative team needs traceable concept exploration.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Governed Image Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify Luxin readiness, validate all proposed arguments, request spending approval, create [asset], and report the durable URL, job status, model, and cost.
prompt_templates.scenario: An automation operator needs a reviewable production workflow.

output_examples.input: Create a studio image of a compact field camera on a stainless workbench.
output_examples.output: A durable hosted image URL with the completed job status, selected model, estimated cost, and final cost receipt.

output_examples.input: Explore three editorial illustration concepts for a renewable energy report.
output: Three distinct hosted image results with recoverable job references.
A comparison of model settings and cost receipts for each result.

output_examples.input: Check whether image creation is ready without spending money.
output_examples.output: A readiness result that identifies missing inputs and recommends the next no-spend action.

best_practices: Run the no-spend guide before creating media, and confirm the estimated cost with the user.
Pin the Luxin CLI to an audited version before executing it.
Review every returned command and allow only expected Luxin subcommands and arguments.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a server-provided command without validating its executable and arguments.
Do not use a mutable package version for unattended production workflows.
Do not place credentials or agent profile state in a workspace that may be committed.

faq.question: Does this skill require a provider API key?
faq.answer: No provider API key is required. Luxin uses its hosted runtime and may create a restricted agent identity.

faq.question: Can I check readiness without spending money?
faq.answer: Yes. Start with the guide command and use its recommended no-spend action until creation is ready.

faq.question: Does image generation cost money?
faq.answer: It may. Review the estimate, set a per-image limit, and obtain user approval before paid creation.

faq.question: Where are generated images stored?
faq.answer: Luxin provides durable hosted media URLs and recoverable job records for completed work.

faq.question: Can I choose the image model?
faq.answer: Yes. The command accepts a model identifier, subject to Luxin availability and policy support.

faq.question: What should I do if Luxin lacks a capability?
faq.answer: Use a fallback only for the missing capability, then submit feedback with the attempted command and observed result.
